description: Stores the pages of the in-game tutorial/help popup: which tutorial flow each page belongs to, its heading and message keys, and the explanation images (including keyboard/controller-specific variants) shown beside the text.

Id.technical: FName row key collected from all TutorialWidgetDataTables. ShowTutorialTypes does not filter by this ID; it filters by TutorialWidgetType and appends matching rows in table/row-name order, which becomes the page sequence. The ID is therefore a unique row key rather than a runtime selection key in the reconstructed consumer.

TutorialWidgetType.simple: Tutorial flow/category this page belongs to.
TutorialWidgetType.technical: EGameTutorialWidgetType (None, Move=1 through Adapt=45, Invalid=255). ShowTutorial(Type) calls ShowTutorialTypes with one type; the latter scans all rows for each requested type in the supplied type-list order and appends them to the displayed page array. Exported rows use 38 distinct types, with some types contributing several pages.

Id_TutorialLabel.simple: Localized heading shown at the top of the page.
Id_TutorialLabel.technical: FName passed directly to HeaderText->SetTextIdOnly on every SetPage call.

Id_TutorialMessage.simple: Localized body text for the tutorial page.
Id_TutorialMessage.technical: FName passed to ExplanationText_1 or ExplanationText_2 depending on whether the page has images. A hard-coded legacy key TUT_OUTGAME_MESSAGE_1301 is rewritten to TUT_OUTGAME_MESSAGE_1304 at display time; all other keys are passed through unchanged.

TutorialTextureName.simple: Ordered list of explanation image names for the page.
TutorialTextureName.technical: TArray<FName>. Names are split into WidgetTexture primary-asset loaders or Win64 platform-streamed loads according to the parallel switch array. None entries are skipped while loading. SetPage reads indices 0 and 1 unchecked to decide between the image layout and text-only layout; ApplyPageTextures later maps non-None names in order onto ExplanationImages and shows each loaded texture.

bSwitchPlatformTutorialTexture.simple: Parallel flags selecting input-device-specific image variants.
bSwitchPlatformTutorialTexture.technical: TArray<bool> aligned with TutorialTextureName by index; retail indexes it unchecked. True names are loaded as /Game/Widgets/StreamingAssets/Tutorial/Win64/<Name>_Win64_Keyboard and <Name>_Win64_Controller; false names go through GamePrimaryAssetType_WidgetTexture. ApplyPageTextures strips '_Win64' and selects the Keyboard or Controller variant based on the active EGameWidgetInputGuideType before applying it to the page image.

notes: The export contains 54 rows. Most rows have two image names; the arrays must stay the same length because SetPage/loader code indexes both arrays positionally, and indices 0/1 are read unguarded.

Only one table consumer is identified: UGameTutorialWidget. Callers supply one or more EGameTutorialWidgetType values; the table itself does not encode prerequisites or ordering beyond table/row order.
The platform-specific suffix and Win64 directory are hard-coded in the reconstructed retail flow; no other platform path is assumed.
Only the supplied retail export and partial Content are available; no claim is made about all Blueprint or editor-tool uses.

usages.detail: Collects all rows, keeps those matching the requested tutorial types in order, and starts the appropriate texture loads.
SetPage applies the row's label/message keys, chooses image vs text-only layout, and updates page navigation buttons.
ApplyPageTextures attaches the current page's loaded normal/platform image textures to the explanation image widgets.
